summary: Iteration 31 — Validated the image-storage refactor end-to-end (backend + web). All 9 pytest cases pass: admin auth-gated survey/status/shrink, shrink is idempotent and returns the documented shape, GET /api/cities/aigraels/vargath is < 5KB with an /api/image/<id> ref (no data: base64), GET /api/cities?nation=aigraels leaks no data: URLs, and /api/image/<id> serves image/png bytes. Web Admin Dashboard → Database tab renders both the existing repair-world-btn and the new shrink-image-btn; clicking Shrink triggers the success toast and populates the shrink-image-result panel ('all clear ✓', 0 remaining across locations/cities/nations, consistent with the recent DB reset).
critical_code_review_comments: routes/admin.py `shrink_image_storage` correctly stops at the first non-empty collection each call — the frontend loops until done, so this is fine, but a comment would help future maintainers.

cities_locations.py `get_city` and `list_cities` both pop `image_id` and rebuild `image_url` as `/api/image/<id>` — good. Legacy `image_url` base64 is stripped from projection so payloads stay tiny. Verified 3KB response for vargath.
image_service.py `migrate_embedded_batch` correctly $unsets image_url even on failed decode so a bad blob cannot wedge the loop — nice.
